notes: Redis frequently ships with no authentication. An unauthenticated, network-exposed instance is high impact: data disclosure and, when writable, remote code execution via well-known techniques.

checks.title: Unauthenticated Redis access
checks.validation: Issue a single read-only INFO once with approval; if it succeeds without AUTH, access is anonymous. Do not modify data.

checks.title: Writable Redis — potential RCE
checks.when: unauthenticated and CONFIG SET / write is permitted
checks.validation: Confirm write access read-only first (CONFIG GET dir). Do NOT write keys/webshells without explicit operator approval and scope.
